# Cncf Kubara Reviewer

Review kubara using its official documentation and repository in the Provisioning / Automation &amp; Configuration category. A single binary CLI tool written in Go to bootstrap, build, and package Kubernetes platforms.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
